I'd like to discuss https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627 - the `produceBlockV4WithBid` Beacon API endpoint - on the CL breakout. Implementation-wise it should be simple and 2 POC implementations already exist (Lodestar, Lighthouse). I've been [proposing blocks](https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-8.ethpandaops.io/slots/filtered?f=&f.graffiti=Vero+BYOB) on plataberget using this endpoint, without issues, for over a week now.

The most important concern is how this endpoint affects network robustness during suboptimal network conditions (non-finality, reorgs, ...). Validator clients that use this endpoint should make it simple to disable VC-side bid selection, in which case the regular `produceBlockV4` endpoint gets called. Therefore I personally don't think this endpoint makes things much worse during bad network conditions, whereas it does have benefits for multi-node setups during normal conditions.
